correctness.rationale: Direct Euler-trail criterion plus signed edge-flow parametrization covers exactly zero divergence and six unit-imbalance sectors. A complete three-vertex disconnected-support classification removes precisely the three forbidden families. Substitution yields the displayed integer rational series; leading pole has coefficient 7/12. Two independently implemented finite checkers matched the first 10 and 12 coefficients from matrices and words respectively, but finite checks are not treated as proof.

value.rationale: The exact distinguishable-signature population for window-two multiset reads on a ternary alphabet is a natural reconstruction invariant, not a chosen arbitrary slice.
